name: Xoi xiu
summary: Xôi xíu is sticky rice with xá xíu, lạp xưởng, and a savory sauce. Dân Việt puts it on phố Bắc Ninh. VnExpress puts it on Hoàng Văn Thụ and Hàng Sắt. Both streets stay. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Nam Định street snack. The Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018 names it in a list and does not describe it. Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 and VnExpress on 18 March 2016 describe the bowl.
texture: VnExpress calls the rice chewy and fragrant, the sausage rich, and the xá xíu soft and sweet, with pepper in the sauce. Eat it while it is still steaming.
howToEat: As a street portion. Mix the bowl. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Phố Bắc Ninh on Dân Việt. Hoàng Văn Thụ and Hàng Sắt on VnExpress. Both stay.
seoTitle: Xoi xiu — sticky rice and char siu in Nam Dinh
seoDescription: Sticky rice with xá xíu, sausage, and sauce on Bắc Ninh, or on Hoàng Văn Thụ and Hàng Sắt. A clock and a price are Check on arrival.
